hypothesis: An unusually large volatility-normalized daily loss followed by an observable partial recovery can identify forced selling exhaustion in liquid US technology assets.

signal_contract.volatility: rolling 20-session standard deviation of close returns, lagged one session
signal_contract.confirmation: next close recovers at least the configured fraction of the preceding close-to-close loss

selection.train_score: profit_factor times sqrt(number_of_trades), penalized when max drawdown exceeds 15 percent

holdout_policy: Open only for the single preselected finalist if every validation and OOS gate passes; otherwise remain sealed.
mapping_limits: QQQ is not directly executable on Ostium. NDXUSD parity and native execution costs must be certified before paper trading. Historical high/low is used only as a conservative risk audit, not to generate signals.
